phantom.summary: A Rogue tied to death who spreads Sneak Attack as ghostly wails and carries trinkets holding fragments of souls.

Wails from the Grave.summary: Right after dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, a second creature you see within 30 ft of the first takes Necrotic damage from half your Sneak Attack dice (round up). DEX-mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Whispers of the Dead.summary: After each Short or Long Rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack; it lasts until you pick another.

Tokens of the Departed.summary: Hold two soul trinkets (3 at Rogue 13, 4 at 17) that return to you past 30 ft; refill to two each Long Rest, or gain one by Reaction when a creature you see dies within 30 ft. While you hold one you have Advantage on Death and CON saves; destroy one to fire a free Wails from the Grave after Sneak Attack, or (Magic action) to cast Augury with CON or question its spirit.

options.name: Death’s Knell
options.summary: After dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, destroy a trinket to use Wails from the Grave without spending a use.

options.name: Life Essence
options.summary: With at least one trinket, Advantage on Death Saving Throws and CON saves.

options.name: Spirit Query
options.summary: Magic action: destroy a trinket to cast Augury without components (CON as the ability), or ask its known spirit one question.

options.name: Gaining Additional Soul Trinkets
options.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft dies: gain a trinket, replacing one if at your maximum.

Voice of Death.summary: Cast Speak with Dead once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or components (DEX as the ability), and target a soul trinket in place of a corpse.

Ghost Walk.summary: Bonus Action: spectral form for 10 minutes: Fly 10 ft with hover, attacks against you have Disadvantage, and move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end a turn inside). Once per Long Rest; destroying a trinket restores it.

Death’s Friend.summary: Wails from the Grave can hit the first creature with its Necrotic damage too, and rolling Initiative with no trinkets gives you one.

options.name: Death’s Lament
options.summary: Wails from the Grave damages both the Sneak Attack target and the second creature.

options.name: Draw of Death
options.summary: On rolling Initiative with no soul trinkets, gain one.
